meta.description: Semantic layer — exact definitions of every KPI. The dashboard and the AI Investigation Assistant must cite these definitions; no other definitions are valid.
meta.disclosure: Orders are a real Kaggle food-delivery dataset; the refund layer is synthetic and seeded (disclosed in docs/risk_scoring_methodology.md). Risk score != proof of fraud. Planted labels exist only to validate the ranking.

total_orders.definition: Count of delivery order records in scope.

customers.definition: Distinct customers with at least one order in scope.

refund_exposure.definition: Total historical refund value in scope. Historical spend measure — NOT a confirmed loss and NOT future revenue at risk.

refund_rate.definition: Share of orders that requested a refund.
refund_rate.denominator: All orders in scope (completed or not)

flagged_customers.definition: Customers in the scored pool — the eligibility funnel (>=5 total orders AND refund rate > 30%) flags them for triage review. A flag means investigate, never guilty.

flagged_exposure_share.definition: Share of total refund exposure held by flagged customers.

fraud_risk_score.definition: Weighted triage score over the eligible pool, min-max scaled 0-100. NOT a probability of fraud (uncalibrated composite heuristic).
fraud_risk_score.formula: 40% refund rate + 30% reason repetition + 20% refund frequency + 10% reason length

high_tier_precision.definition: Share of High-tier flags that match the seeded (planted) high-risk labels. Validation only — planted labels are synthetic.
high_tier_precision.formula: High-tier flags with Planted_Risk = 'High' / all High-tier flags
high_tier_precision.caveat: n = 8. In-pool AUC 0.942; end-to-end recall 2.7% (coverage gap disclosed).

volume_band_baseline.definition: Per-band P95 of customer refund rate. 'Above baseline' = refund rate above the P95 of the customer's order-volume band (1-2, 3-5, 6-10, 11-20, 21+).
volume_band_baseline.caveat: Above baseline != fraudulent — it means statistically unusual for their activity level.

below_baseline_flags.definition: Flagged customers whose refund rate is at or below their volume-band P95 — normal for their volume, hence likely false positives.
below_baseline_flags.formula: flagged customers WHERE Refund_Rate <= band P95

pareto_concentration.definition: Share of total refund value held by the top X% of customers ranked by refund value.

mom_delta.definition: Month-over-month change of a KPI (latest month vs previous month). Alert threshold: 10% relative change (rate: 2 pp).
